problem_statement: The primary NAV receipt records a passing local software test while an independent candidate source reports that one behavior did not survive a separate reproduction attempt.
current_capabilities: run the existing NAV and crossing unit tests
constraints: do not modify production behavior merely to force agreement
preserve raw result artifacts before interpretation
preserve: explicit uncertainty about which report generalizes

reversible_levers.change: Add a test-only reproduction fixture that records the environment manifest, exact inputs, raw outputs, and exit status for the disputed behavior.
reversible_levers.rollback: Remove the test-only fixture and its workflow hook while retaining the captured evidence artifacts and receipts.

reversible_levers.change: Add test-only structured diagnostic logging around the disputed behavior without changing the behavior itself.
reversible_levers.rollback: Remove the diagnostic logging and retain the captured logs as evidence artifacts.

observation_channels.description: Run the reproduction fixture in a fresh isolated environment whose manifest is captured with the result.
observation_channels.capture: environment manifest, exact command, raw stdout/stderr, exit status, and generated test artifact
